captions.detailed: A handheld immersion blender consisting of a dark grey cylindrical motor housing, a black spherical top cap, two side buttons, and a detachable metallic grey blending shaft. The bottom of the blending shaft flares out into a bell-shaped guard that houses the blade assembly. The motor housing and blending shaft are connected via a revolute joint representing a quarter-turn bayonet lock, while the blade assembly at the tip rotates continuously about the central axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a handheld immersion blender. The model should include a main cylindrical motor body with a rounded top and small side buttons, a detachable lower blending shaft, and a blade guard at the tip, utilizing a revolute joint to simulate the detachable bayonet lock.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a Cylinder primitive for the motor housing, capped with a Sphere on top and detailed with small Box primitives for buttons. Model the detachable shaft assembly using a thin Cylinder for the rod and a loft or combined Cylinder/Sphere shapes for the flared bell guard at the tip. Define a revolute articulation (with limited rotation) between the main body and the shaft to represent the locking mechanism, and a continuous articulation for the internal blade rotation.
